## Summary
## Related issue / module
## Changes and acceptance criteria
## Tests actually run and results
## STB / Windows compatibility and resource impact
## Security, migrations, backup and rollback
- [ ] Module boundaries preserved
- [ ] Tests and documentation updated
- [ ] No credentials or private device data included

## UI/UX (required for user-facing changes)
- [ ] Applied meshwall-ui-ux skill and shared design tokens
- [ ] Inspected actual screenshots at relevant desktop/mobile sizes, or explicitly documented why unavailable
- [ ] Checked loading/empty/error states, keyboard navigation, contrast and layout density
- [ ] Corrected defects and rechecked; no sensitive screens or tokens in evidence
- [ ] Reported remaining visual, integration and performance blockers
